solutions.check: grid and clues read from the FT's printable PDF, its numbering matching the clue list; every fifteensquared answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Take over when birds return

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

indicators.note: to return is to come back, so the birds' name is read backwards

parts.note: emus are large flightless birds

explanation.surface: Someone takes charge just as the migrating birds come home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' reads the birds backwards; 'when' is the conjunction as, not a time signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To assume control or a role is to take it over, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Drug users did wrong, breaking laws

indicators.note: breaking into something means getting inside it, so one piece goes into the other

parts.note: acts of parliament are laws

indicators.note: done wrong, so the three letters of the word did are put in another order

explanation.surface: People on drugs behaved badly and broke the law.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrong' scrambles the clue's own word did; 'breaking' looks like breaking the law but means getting inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Addicts are people dependent on a substance, here drug users.

clue.text: Vessel requiring a mast to be re-rigged

indicators.note: rigging a ship again means rearranging its parts, so these letters are set out anew

explanation.surface: A ship can't sail until its mast has been rigged again.
explanation.walkthrough: 're-rigged' rearranges the nine letters of A MAST TO BE.
explanation.definitionFit: A steamboat is a kind of boat driven by steam, so it is a vessel.

clue.text: Foreign capital comes up in my reminiscences

definitions.note: plural in the clue, but a memory here means a store of recollections collectively

indicators.note: one piece goes inside the other
in a down clue, coming up means the word is read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: Rome is the capital of Italy, a foreign capital to the setter

explanation.surface: In my recollections, a foreign city keeps coming up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comes up' turns ROME into EMOR, which goes 'in' MY.
explanation.definitionFit: Reminiscences are recollections of the past, which is what memory holds.

clue.text: In a way has a gift for scrawled drawing

indicators.note: in a way here means arranged in some other way, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Somehow, someone has a talent for doodling on walls.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In a way' rearranges the letters of A GIFT FOR; 'has' just links.
explanation.definitionFit: A graffito is a single piece of graffiti, a drawing or writing scrawled on a wall.

clue.text: Over-disposed to wander

indicators.note: disposed can mean arranged or set out, so the letters are placed in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone over-inclined to drift about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disposed' rearranges OVER.
explanation.definitionFit: To rove is to roam or wander about without fixed direction.

clue.text: Strict control for company employee

parts.note: a firm is a business company
a hand is a worker, as in farmhand

explanation.surface: A business needs discipline over its staff.
explanation.definitionFit: A firm hand is an idiom for strict, steady control.

clue.text: Finally included without exception

definitions.meaning: when everything is finally counted together, the total sum
everyone or everything taken together, with none left out

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means in total, everything counted, and also all without exception.

clue.text: An old Empire sofa

definitions.meaning: the Turkish empire centred on Constantinople that ended in 1922
a low upholstered seat or couch without a back

explanation.surface: An antique sofa in the Empire style.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the historic Turkish empire and a backless padded couch.

clue.text: My dear, it can be quite impractical

indicators.note: says the letters can be made into the answer, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A fond remark that a loved one can be rather unrealistic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it can be' rearranges the letters of MY DEAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone dreamy is lost in fancies and so is impractical.

clue.text: Not very bright but in charge of the players

parts.note: over means having authority above, as a manager is over staff
the cast is the set of actors in a play

explanation.surface: A theatre director is not very clever but runs the actors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not very bright' looks like a jibe at a person; it describes cloudy weather.
explanation.definitionFit: Overcast weather is cloudy and dull, so not very bright.

clue.text: Ghostly appearance of horse without carriage

indicators.note: in its old sense of outside, so one piece wraps round the other

parts.note: a mare is a female horse
a cab is a horse-drawn carriage for hire

explanation.surface: A spectral horse is seen without its carriage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, not lacking; 'appearance of' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Macabre means grim and ghastly, dealing with death and the spectral.

clue.text: Welsh river name

parts.note: the Cam is the river through Cambridge
Brian is a man's name

explanation.surface: The name of a river in Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Cambrian means of Wales, from Cambria, the Latin name for the country.

clue.text: See in quiet morning with a Jewish greeting

indicators.note: one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: sh is a call for silence
M is short for morning, as in a.m.
lo is an old word meaning see or look

explanation.surface: Greeting someone quietly in the morning with a Hebrew word.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts LO into SH, A and M combined, SHAM.
explanation.definitionFit: Shalom is the Hebrew word for peace used as hello and goodbye.

clue.text: Sound cheerful while going round the short way

indicators.note: one piece circles the other, enclosing it

parts.note: the clue word gives its own letters
St is the short form of street, a way

explanation.surface: Whistling happily while taking a shortcut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'while' supplies its own letters; 'going round' is the enclosing signal, and 'the short way' is an abbreviated street.
explanation.definitionFit: To whistle a tune is a typical way of sounding cheerful.

clue.text: Female carrying oxygen pump, say

indicators.note: one piece holds the other inside it

parts.note: she is a female pronoun
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: A woman with an oxygen pump for breathing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pump' suggests a machine; it is a light dance shoe, and 'say' marks it as one example.
explanation.definitionFit: A pump is a type of light, low-cut shoe, given as an example.

clue.text: The first president was nothing out of the ordinary

parts.note: the clue word gives its own letters

indicators.note: unusual, so the letters of nothing are put in an unusual order

explanation.surface: A remark that the first head of state was quite unremarkable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out of the ordinary' rearranges NOTHING into HINGTON.
explanation.definitionFit: George Washington was the first President of the United States.

clue.text: Taste before consuming popular fruit

parts.note: tang is a sharp taste

indicators.note: eating something takes it inside, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: ere is an old word for before
in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: Have a taste before eating the popular fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'consuming' is the container signal: the popular piece is eaten by the old word for before.
explanation.definitionFit: A tangerine is a small citrus fruit like a mandarin.

clue.text: Cheat to secure point in card-game

parts.note: to crib is to copy dishonestly
to bag is to obtain or secure
E is east, a compass point

explanation.surface: Cheating to win a point in a game of cards.
explanation.definitionFit: Cribbage is a card game scored with pegs on a board.

clue.text: Gain admission by force and initiative

parts.note: to enter is to get in
to prise is to force open with a lever

explanation.surface: Breaking in shows a certain boldness.
explanation.walkthrough: PRISE is the British spelling of prize, to lever open.
explanation.definitionFit: Enterprise means initiative and resourcefulness in starting things.

clue.text: Impressions left by the dead

definitions.meaning: the impressions made on an audience
personal belongings left behind when someone dies

explanation.definitionFit: Effects means both impressions produced and a person's belongings, as left at death.

clue.text: Supporter of proposal?

parts.note: not a backer of a motion but the leg joint a suitor rests on when asking for a hand in marriage

explanation.definitionFit: A suitor traditionally goes down on one knee, so it supports a marriage proposal.

clue.text: Tried and tested

explanation.definitionFit: To essay is both to attempt something and, archaically, to test it.

clue.text: It's the devil to turn when there's a collision

parts.note: an imp is a little devil
a turn is a performer's act on stage

explanation.surface: It's hellish turning when a crash is coming.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn' looks like a reversal signal but is the stage act.
explanation.definitionFit: Impact is the forceful striking of one thing against another, a collision.

clue.text: Meat in an iron container cooked in blazing brandy

indicators.note: one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron
lamb is the meat of a young sheep

explanation.surface: Meat in an iron pan flamed with brandy.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface's 'iron container' is a pan; in the wordplay the iron symbol is what holds the meat, signalled by 'in'.
explanation.definitionFit: Flambé describes food set alight with brandy or spirit in the cooking.

clue.text: A timber at right angles to a ship's keel

definitions.text: at right angles to a ship's keel

parts.note: a beam is a length of timber

explanation.surface: A ship's timber laid across the keel.
explanation.definitionFit: Abeam is the nautical term for a direction perpendicular to a ship's length.

clue.text: Gets up, but it involves a scramble

definitions.text: Gets up, but it involves a scramble

parts.words: Gets up, but it involves a scramble
parts.note: describes rising or climbing awkwardly on hands and feet

explanation.definitionFit: To clamber is to climb with effort, scrambling up using hands and feet.

clue.text: Putting the head in charge is fair

indicators.note: one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a fee is a charge for a service

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Putting the boss in charge is only fair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'head' takes T from 'the', which goes 'in' FEE.
explanation.definitionFit: A fête is an outdoor fair, often raising money for charity.

clue.text: Made about a thousand to be burnt

indicators.note: around, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: to create is to make
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: A thousand were made only to be burnt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts M inside CREATED.
explanation.definitionFit: Cremated means burnt to ashes, as a body at a funeral.

clue.text: Blood group

definitions.meaning: one's blood means one's kin and lineage
a group of related plants or animals in classification

explanation.definitionFit: Family means one's kin, one's own blood, and a taxonomic group.

clue.text: Immersed, cooked and gently boiled

indicators.note: cooked means altered or tampered with, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Something was plunged into the pot, cooked, and kept just under the boil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' rearranges IMMERSED.
explanation.definitionFit: To simmer is to cook in liquid kept just below boiling.

clue.text: Be there at the start and finish

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter

parts.note: end means finish

explanation.surface: Be present from the beginning to the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'start' takes T from 'the'.
explanation.definitionFit: To attend is to be present at an event.
